svg.title: T12 Electric moped, left side elevation with battery bay cut away
svg.desc: Battery-electric moped: rear hub motor with no chain or belt, swappable lithium battery under the seat shown cut away with its handle, motor controller and DC-DC converter under the floor, charge socket, LED headlight with ring DRL, digital display, front disc and rear drum with regenerative braking, step-through floor, twin rear shocks, under-seat storage and 14 in cast wheels.
